hooks.logic:
Let list2 be [].
Let v8 be call helper.
If v8 at 0, then
  If v8 at 0 is the character DARK_CECIL and v8 at 1 is the character PALADIN_CECIL or v8 at 0 is the character PALADIN_CECIL and v8 at 1 is the character DARK_CECIL, then
    Append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 0)}] to list2.
    If v8 at 2, then append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 2)}] to list2.
  Otherwise
    Append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 0)}] to list2.
    If v8 at 1, then append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 1)}] to list2.
Queue the pose-change sequence list2.
Put queued moves ahead of counters.

yes.text: v8 at 0 is the character DARK_CECIL and v8 at 1 is the character PALADIN_CECIL or v8 at 0 is the character PALADIN_CECIL and v8 at 1 is the character DARK_CECIL
Append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 0)}] to list2.
Append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 2)}] to list2.

no.text: Append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 0)}] to list2.

yes.text: Append [{messageSuffixNo: data at (v8 at 1)}] to list2.

flow.text: Put queued moves ahead of counters.

hooks.logic:
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not currentParamSuffixNo, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled v2 on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityTag: v, abilityOptions: {skipStepCnt: true}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "22"}]]}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityTag: v2, skipMessage: false, skipAttackMotion: true, skipStepCnt: false}].
  Otherwise, if ability is the id of the move labelled v4 on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityTag: v3, abilityOptions: {skipStepCnt: true}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityTag: v4, abilityOptions: {skipMessage: false, skipAttackMotion: true, skipStepCnt: false}}].
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.

flow.text: Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.

yes.text: The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
ability is the id of the move labelled v2 on the enemy

The enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityTag: v, abilityOptions: {skipStepCnt: true}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "22"}]]}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityTag: v2, skipMessage: false, skipAttackMotion: true, skipStepCnt: false}].

no.text: ability is the id of the move labelled v4 on the enemy

yes.text: The enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityTag: v3, abilityOptions: {skipStepCnt: true}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityTag: v4, abilityOptions: {skipMessage: false, skipAttackMotion: true, skipStepCnt: false}}].
